name: Lee University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2026-2027 basic tuition (full-time 12-16 hrs) $25,440 + Student Services Fee $820 = $26,260 tuition & fees, from leeuniversity.edu 2026-2027 'Estimate Your School Bill' PDF. Housing is room only: standard residence halls (Davis, Sharp, Tharp, Atkins-Ellis, Cross, New Hughes) $2,300/semester = $4,600/yr; other halls range $1,890-$2,860/semester. Meals (board) billed separately (e.g. unlimited $2,710/semester).
